expectations.notes: Google's aggregator confirmation template. Bullet-separated layout: 'DOW, Mon Day · city to city dep_time–arr_time · duration IATA (...) IATA (...)'. Date often lacks a year so we fall back to received_at via _parse_partial_date_time.
